notes: Gloamgarden sporekin: a mushroom cap over a petal skirt. The mesh is modelled turned 30 degrees towards its left (feet and hands both lie on a line 30 degrees off X), so it is fitted facing forward and the bind is turned to face +Z. The overhand smash and the zombie claw both fold the spine far enough to lay the wide cap over the whole body, so it casts (Spell_Simple) instead: the branch arm thrusts forward and the cap stays up. Its root feet splay from the floor and the fit ran each leg out along a sideways root, with the ankle on a root tip half a metre from the shin, so the roots near the shin rode the calf and sank; the knees, ankles, balls and forward root tips are given (faced frame).
